scope: Ordinary GroupTick recall transfer and traced hold lifecycle; not complete STOP receipt protocol
findings: Near-leader holders were removed even when group follow admission refused
Nonlocal living same-group holders were pruned during temporary split locality
Standing cover/completed/failed-bound holds and transient retry stops are distinct source cases; historical holder membership is not exact per-actor STOP ownership
implementation: Atomically bind holder filtering and recall transfer to current state, epoch, operation generation and original holder rows
Retain nonlocal living same-group holders without commands
Retire old hold membership only for actors actually issued native follow
Refuse actors with protected tasks, finite movement reservations, external owners or current drill membership
bounds: Existing roster/cadence only, no new worker or discovery. Extra actor predicates/copies scale with holder count; actual overhead unmeasured.
remaining: Exact per-actor STOP receipt across standing hold issuers, rejoin, retreat, calm, checkpoint and locality adoption
Failed support-bound hold is not ordinary holder membership; transient retry stop must not become a standing lease
Other locality cleanup may still discard unavailable actors; only GroupTick is changed
Issued follow is not physical rejoin
